# observability_wire

Purpose: transport-independent wire contracts for Prometheus, Loki and Tempo
queries. Pure Dart, no dependencies, no I/O.

Read first:
- README.md
- lib/observability_wire.dart

Main APIs:
- lib/src/requests.dart (WireRequest, PrometheusRequests, LokiRequests, TempoRequests)
- lib/src/metrics.dart (normalizeMetricData, envelope helpers, legends)
- lib/src/loki.dart (normalizeLokiStreams)
- lib/src/tempo.dart (normalizeTempoSearch, parseTempoTrace, parseTempoTags, normalizeTraceId)
- lib/src/planning.dart (planStepSeconds, expandMacros, time formats)
- lib/src/errors.dart (decodeUpstreamJson, redactText, ObservabilityUpstreamException)

Rules:
- No I/O and no imports beyond dart:core, dart:convert and dart:math.
- Error messages must never contain a source URL or credential; pass them as `secrets`.

Validation:
- dart analyze
- dart test
